thread:
Ana (AM): Kickstarting Aurora POC. Must support SAML SSO, SCIM bulk import (~500k), RBAC mapping, domain-claim verification, and an on-prem air-gapped prod option. Need blockers + pricing range for Thurs exec review.
Ben (SE): Quick Qs: do they expect hourly deltas or sub-minute updates? Also what's acceptable cutover window for initial import?
Riley (Eng): For 500k recommend chunking 2k-8k per request, concurrency 8-12, and exponential backoff (base 1s, cap 60s) for 429s. Hourly deltas are typical; sub-minute requires SAML attribute enforcement or webhooks with rate limits.
Riley (Eng): SCIM bulk example (POSIX friendly): ```bash
curl -X POST https://scim.redwood.example.com/v2/Bulk -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @bulk.json
```
Sam (Infra): On-prem air-gap details: we need full network topology, inventory, RTO/RPO, and a signed SOW if they want no control-plane access. Support overhead increases ~15% and there is a one-time deployment fee.
Ana (AM): They project ~210 TPS auth checks at peak. What does that imply for Dedicated sizing vs Hosted fallback?
Ben (SE): 210 TPS -> Dedicated reserved capacity recommended for steady latency. Suggest 2 reserved nodes steady-state + burst pool. I'll draft pricing bands: Dedicated baseline, Hosted-fallback unit rates, and air-gap uplift.
sec-bot: sec-bot: security pack delivered -> https://redwood.example.com/sec/aurora-pack-2026
Riley (Eng): RBAC pattern: use SCIM groups->roles for bootstrap and periodic syncs; rely on SAML role assertions for immediate session enforcement. We can emit change webhooks for near-real-time updates but document scaling caveats.
Sam (Infra): KMS: we support customer-managed KMS for Private; air-gapped on-prem requires local HSM and audited key transfer. Legal must sign key-handling addendum.
Ana (AM): Action items: (1) Ana collect network diagram + SAML metadata + QPS cert; (2) Riley prepare SCIM runbook (chunking, backoff, sample payloads); (3) Ben produce pricing ranges (Dedicated, Hosted fallback, air-gap uplift & one-off fee); (4) Sam prepare KMS/HSM checklist and support uplift numbers. Sync Wed EOD. :thumbsup:
